name: g1
_note: G1 stand driven by the in-engine WHOLE-BODY CONTROLLER as operational-space feedforward ON TOP of the position servo (OMNISIM_INENGINE_TSID=1 + TSID_FF=1 + TSID_TICK=1, servo ke=400/kd=60, NOT torque mode). The servo holds the centered squat (ank_bias -0.06 -- the proven Newton CoM-back trim); the WBC adds a bounded balance torque each tick (CoM task J_com^T F_com + torso-orientation task J_baseR^T a_ori) that actively rejects perturbations (cube throws). Runs at TICK rate so the CUDA graph stays enabled (fast sim). The reactive lean/arm overlays are OFF so the WBC is the sole active balancer on top of the static servo. (A pure-torque variant -- TSID_TICK off, TORQUE_MODE on, ke=kd=0 -- exists but is not durable: importer ipos=0 makes CPU gravity-comp inaccurate.)
